members.bio: Two kids at Maple St School. I host the block cleanups.
PTA chair. Ask me about the book fair.
Garden coordinator. Plot 1, the one with the scarecrow.
Run club founder. Slow miles, good company.
Kindergarten parent, room helper on Fridays.
Coach for the Saturday kids run.
Corner house with the big maple.
Marathoner in training. Lives on Elm.
Plot 3, herbs and too much mint.
Retired teacher, crossing guard on Tuesdays.
Seed swaps, sourdough and the occasional banjo.
Plot 9. Squash every year, no regrets.
Plot 14, flowers for the school office.
Fixes bikes on the stoop on Sundays.
Parent of twins. Runs to stay sane.
Dog walker, knows every dog on the block.
Runs to the garden and back.
